faqs.q: What is the validity of rewards points earned via American Express® Platinum Travel Credit Card?
faqs.a: +- American Express® Platinum Travel Credit Card lets you earn Membership Rewards Points on your transactions, which never expire. You can redeem the reward points earned via this credit card till the card is active. However, in case of any card cancellation, the reward points will get forfeited within 30 days of the cancellation.

faqs.q: Can I convert my American Express® Platinum Travel Credit Card purchases into EMI?
faqs.a: +- Yes, you can convert your purchases of Rs. 5,000 or above into easy EMIs. For offline transactions, you can ask the merchant for the EMI option at the point of sale before making the purchase. To avail this option on online purchases, you can select the EMI option while checking out.

faqs.q: Does American Express® Platinum Travel Credit Card allow contactless payment?
faqs.a: +- Yes, you can tap and pay through this credit card without entering any OTP. However, this option is available only on your purchases below Rs. 5,000. All you need to do is touch your card at the POS machine to make a transaction. Also, to check whether your card has this feature or not, you can look for contactless symbol at the front or back of your card.

faqs.question: Is the American Express Platinum Travel Credit Card currently available?
faqs.answer: American Express has temporarily paused new applications for the Platinum Travel Credit Card in India. Existing cardholders can continue to use the card and earn milestone rewards under the revised benefit structure.

faqs.question: What is the annual fee for the American Express Platinum Travel Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The American Express Platinum Travel Credit Card has a joining fee and annual renewal fee of ₹5000 + GST. There is no annual fee waiver based on spending. Referral applications may be issued First Year Free when the offer is available.

faqs.question: What are the milestone benefits on the American Express Platinum Travel Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The card offers 7500 bonus Membership Rewards Points on spending ₹1.90 lakh, an additional 10,000 bonus Membership Rewards Points on reaching ₹4 lakh and another 22,500 bonus Membership Rewards Points plus a ₹10,000 Taj Experiences E-Gift Card on spending ₹7 lakh in a card membership year.

faqs.question: Do insurance, utility and Income Tax payments count towards Platinum Travel milestones?
faqs.answer: Yes. Insurance, utility, fuel and government or Income Tax payments generally count towards annual milestone spending even though they do not earn regular Membership Rewards Points. Eligible transactions remain subject to the latest American Express terms and conditions.

faqs.question: How many Membership Rewards Points can I earn on spending ₹7 lakh?
faqs.answer: On completing ₹7 lakh of eligible annual spending, you can earn up to 54,000 Membership Rewards Points, including both base and milestone rewards, along with a ₹10,000 Taj Experiences E-Gift Card.

faqs.question: What is the best way to redeem Membership Rewards Points earned on the Platinum Travel Credit Card?
faqs.answer: Marriott Bonvoy transfers generally provide the highest value, followed by The Postcard Hotel and Taj voucher redemptions. Cardholders who also hold an American Express MRCC or Gold Charge Card can access the Gold Collection, which unlocks additional high-value redemption options.

faqs.question: Does the American Express Platinum Travel Credit Card offer airport lounge access?
faqs.answer: The card offers 8 complimentary domestic airport lounge visits every year, limited to 2 visits per calendar quarter, without any spending requirement. It also includes a complimentary Priority Pass membership for international lounges, although lounge visits are chargeable.

program_updates_2026: New Applications Paused: American Express has temporarily paused new card applications in India (existing cardholders unaffected).
From 15 November 2026: Amex counts monthly milestone transactions by posting date (not transaction date) and keeps MR pools separate per card.
Transfer Partners Updated (Aug–Nov 2026): Hilton Honors improved to 1:1.5 (1,000:1,500), Virgin Atlantic improved to 5:4 (800:640), Etihad Guest removed 1 July 2026, Emirates Skywards suspended.

Traditionally known for its “sweet spot” at the ₹4 Lakh spend mark, the card underwent a significant devaluation on March 9, 2026. The milestone rewards have been restructured, shifting the most coveted benefits to a higher spending tier.
Note: Hitting the final milestone yields a total of 54,000 Membership Rewards Points and a ₹10,000 Taj Voucher, assuming all spends are eligible for regular rewards.
